description: This Java class 'KafkaTbVersionControlQueueFactory' implements a factory for creating Kafka-based message producers and consumers specific to version control within the Thingsboard platform. It manages Kafka topics and admin clients for different message types related to version control, notifications, usage stats, and housekeeper messages.

classes.name: KafkaTbVersionControlQueueFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Kafka message producers and consumers for version control, notifications, usage stats, and housekeeper messages in Thingsboard.

methods.name: createTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for core notification messages.

methods.name: createToVersionControlMsgConsumer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka consumer for version control service messages.

methods.name: createToUsageStatsServiceMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for usage stats service messages.

methods.name: createHousekeeperMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for housekeeper service messages.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Pre-destroy method to clean up Kafka admin clients.
